items.title: 52043_Herman Autrey oral history interview
items.q: They had a blues singer in there, you know, one of the Smiths, Bessie Smith, Mamie Smith, but mainly Bessie, and Clara. Clara wasn't bad. She was very good. Trixie Smith. I played for all of them.

ctx.x: No, no, Clara wasn't in that show, but we knew Clara then. Clara, Mamie Smith, all that came a little later. But --

items.title: 52043_Herman Autrey oral history interview
items.q: she used to tell me -- they were from Kentucky... Bessie's sister did.

ctx.x: Had somebody selling it for them, you know, but Bessie's sister had some in her house too, and in fact, she used to tell me -- they were from Kentucky, and -- not Louisville, or -- oh, she had a riverboat. Bessie's sister did. And Kentucky, Kentucky, Kentucky -- Louis -- not Louisville. I'll think of the name of the town in a minute.
